<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/firmware/upgrade"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Initiate a firmware upgrade for the specified device to the given version. This API only accepts the upgrade request; actual progress and results must be obtained through the status query API.

Before calling this API, please obtain the available firmware version information for the target device using the [POST /firmware/upgradable-devices/search-by-device-ids](https://docs.aqara.com/docs/aqara-developer/data-export-api/search-upgradable-devices-firmware-by-device-ids) API to ensure the correctness and validity of the upgrade operation.
